journal-dark-implemented.alternativeText: Development Journal in dark appearance, with deep indigo panels, light text and the header appearance control.
journal-dark-implemented.caption: Development preview of the Journal in dark mode. Includes labelled demonstration stories; dark mode has not shipped yet.
journal-dark-implemented.provenance: Browser capture of the running development UI after choosing Dark through the real header control. No production account or billing details are shown.

journal-light-implemented.alternativeText: The same development Journal in light appearance, with warm paper, dark ink and indigo accents.
journal-light-implemented.caption: Development preview of the same Journal in light mode. The coming release will offer Light, Dark and System in the header and account settings.
journal-light-implemented.provenance: Browser capture of the running development UI after saving Light in account settings and reloading the page.

ui-overhaul-home.alternativeText: Current development homepage excerpt showing the warm reading surface, serif headline, library search and globe illustration.
ui-overhaul-home.caption: An excerpt from our development homepage. Dark mode is coming with the interface overhaul; it has not shipped yet.
ui-overhaul-home.provenance: Browser capture of the running development UI, clipped to the public homepage hero to exclude account and moderation controls.
